title: Fix backwards normative relationship between JMAP-CHAT and this doc
description: §1 (lines 76-78) says this document 'formalizes the sha256 field introduced in JMAP-CHAT', implying JMAP-CHAT is the origin. For this to be a standalone reusable capability, JMAP-CHAT should cite this document normatively for the sha256 definition, not the other way around. As written, both documents independently define the same field, creating a conformance ambiguity if they diverge. Update JMAP-CHAT to cite this doc normatively; update this doc's framing.
